scripts.clean: npx rimraf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules shared/node_modules
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.copilot:verify: npm run copilot:lint -w client && npm run copilot:lint -w server && npm run copilot:test
scripts.health:backend: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:3001/health').then((res)=>{if(!res.ok) throw new Error('Backend health failed: '+res.status); console.log('HEALTHY 3001');}).catch((err)=>{console.error(err.message); process.exit(1);})"
scripts.health:client: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5173/').then((res)=>{if(res.ok === false) throw new Error('Client health failed: '+res.status); console.log('HEALTHY 5173');}).catch((err)=>{console.error(err.message); process.exit(1);})"
scripts.dev:lifecycle:verify: npm run health:client && npm run health:backend
scripts.dev:lifecycle:cleanup: npm run ports:kill:full && npm run ports:check:full
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
